name: Sitagliptin Phosphate
indications_original:
Sitagliptin tablets are indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus.
                  
                     Limitations of Use
                  
                  Sitagliptin tablets should not be used in patients with type 1 diabetes.
                  Sitagliptin tablets have not been studied in patients with a history of pancreatitis. It is unknown whether patients with a history of pancreatitis are at increased risk for the development of pancreatitis while using sitagliptin tablets. [See Warnings and Precautions (5.1).]
contraindications_original: The recommended dose of sitagliptin tablets is 100 mg once daily. Sitagliptin tablets can be taken with or without food. ( 2.1 ) Dosage adjustment is recommended for patients with eGFR less than 45 mL/min/1.73 m 2 . ( 2.2 ) Dosage Adjustment in Patients with Renal Impairment ( 2.2 ) eGFR greater than or equal to 30 mL/min/1.73 m 2 to less than 45 mL/min/1.73 m 2 eGFR less than 30 mL/min/1.73 m 2 (including patients with end stage renal disease [ESRD] on dialysis) 50 mg once daily 25 mg once daily
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Sitagliptin tablets, USP are available as follows:
                  25 mg tablets are dark pink, round, biconvex, film-coated tablets debossed with “SN” on one side and “25” on the other side. 
                  NDC  0781-5766-31, 30 tablets in one bottle
                  NDC  0781-5766-92, 90 tablets in one bottle
                  50 mg tablets are pink, round, biconvex, film-coated tablets debossed with “SN” on one side and “50” on the other side. 
                   NDC  0781-5768-31, 30 tablets in one bottle
                  NDC  0781-5768-92, 90 tablets in one bottle
                  100 mg tablets are brown, round, biconvex, film-coated tablets debossed with “SN” on one side and “100” on the other side.
                  NDC  0781-5770-31, 30 tablets in one bottle 
                  NDC  0781-5770-92, 90 tablets in one bottle
                  NDC  0781-5770-10, 1000 tablets in one bottle 
                  
                     Storage 
                  
                  Store at 20ºC to 25ºC (68ºF to 77ºF); excursions permitted to 15ºC to 30ºC (69ºF to 86ºF) [see USP Controlled Room Temperature]. 
                  Dispense in a tight, light-resistant container.
                  
                     KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.
